questions.question: A line passes through the points (0, 2) and (3, 14). What is its slope?
questions.explanation: Slope is rise over run: the vertical change (14 - 2 = 12) divided by the horizontal change (3 - 0 = 3). So slope = 12/3 = 4. Dividing run by rise (0.25) inverts it.
